narrative.canopy: The millet capital of Kerala, located on the fringes of the Western Ghats. For generations, the Irula, Muduga, and Kurumba tribes have cultivated these drought-resistant grains.
narrative.land: Their farming practices are an unbroken testament to survival, patience, and absolute ecological alignment.
narrative.hand: The crops are completely rainfed. When the rest of the world moved to subsidized rice, these communities preserved their specific landrace seeds for centuries without external intervention.
